about: What Rust added to the schema after the Python bridge's revision: applied after tests/fixtures/migrate.json by src/store/owned.rs, and by tests/test_core_rows.py to build the database an old Python process meets. Written by hand: Python never produces it. Additive only: Python ignores all of it.
statements:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS question_host (
    id       INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES questions(id),
    host     TEXT NOT NULL,
    terminal TEXT,
    machine  TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS alert_host (
    id       INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES alerts(id),
    host     TEXT NOT NULL,
    terminal TEXT,
    machine  TEXT
)
